definitions.explanation: A numerical proportion or relationship between two quantities; often used as a suffix for specific rates.

examples.japanese: {失業|しつぎょう}{率|りつ}が{下|さ}がった。
{合格|ごうかく}{率|りつ}は{五十|ごじゅう}パーセントだ。
{成功|せいこう}{率|りつ}を{上|あ}げる{方法|ほうほう}を{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: To think of ways to increase the success rate.

notes:
USAGE: {率|りつ} is commonly used as a suffix attached to nouns to indicate a rate or ratio.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{失業|しつぎょう}{率|りつ} (unemployment rate)
・{合格|ごうかく}{率|りつ} (pass rate)
・{成功|せいこう}{率|りつ} (success rate)
・{出席|しゅっせき}{率|りつ} (attendance rate)
・{確率|かくりつ} (probability)
・{効率|こうりつ} (efficiency)
・{比率|ひりつ} (ratio)

NOTE: When used alone as a noun, {率|りつ} typically needs context to specify what rate is meant.
